notes.title: Beta 25-5-1: FFA TTM, Color Customization, and more!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=HwjSlQRAkYc;full][/previewyoutube]

New gametype, map preview
FFA Tag Match and LaserMaze

https://i.imgur.com/whFkARw.gif

Hop in with friends and bots in free-for-all! Enjoy tagging your opponents as you battle it out solo in the LaserArena and new LaserMaze maps!

https://i.imgur.com/th01ht3.jpeg

The LaserMaze is the reintroduction of the prototype map. As we continue to evolve both maps, we're looking to improving the layout and aesthetics of the maps to fit classic and imaginative environments for your laser tagging endeavours!

https://i.imgur.com/Vighp6Z.png

To get into FFA and the LaserMaze map, simply host a game- head to the "maps" tab after configuring the initial settings, and select the map and gametype you want to play. You can add multiple maps and gametype combinations to the map queue. We're looking forward to adding more settings so you can personalize each game on a per gametype and per map basis, as we continue to develop!

https://i.imgur.com/J8yruIy.png

The LaserMaze features various ducts and tunnels which you can crawl through to gain the advantage. Additionally, there's doors which could be opened (in the future) by shooting at a target. Let us know what you think of these new initial level mechanics!

New feature: demo replays (beta)

Demo recording and replays let you record and play back your matches! See what other players are doing, track your skill over time, or show off something crazy! Note that while we fixed a lot of things to get the demo recording system working, there's still the possibility of it crashing, so let us know if/when you encounter an issue over at our discord server: https://quantonium.net/discord.

https://i.imgur.com/Dhv0N09.png
To start a recording, enter the pause menu and look at the bottom-left. Enter a name for the recording, and click "start recording".

https://i.imgur.com/kBX6UQw.png
To stop, simply click stop recording. Additionally, recordings should stop if the match is suddenly closed by yourself or the server (though if the engine crashes it can't stop and save).

https://i.imgur.com/UNbnPUY.png
To play back recordings, on the main menu click the new "demo recordings" button. Select any past recording, and on the bottom-right you can play or delete it.

https://i.imgur.com/Pg9YznP.png
While playing back a recording, press "v" to open the replay controls. You can speed up and slow down the recording, as well as pausing/playing, and scrubbing to a different spot in the recording.

https://i.imgur.com/Pg9YznP.png
We hope you enjoy our implementation of demo recording into the game, and as stated above, let us know if there are any issues with this new feature.

Improved AI

https://i.imgur.com/4lRyRzg.gif

As part of an ongoing project, we have integrated a new WIP AI plugin, made specifically for laser tag AI, and intended to be open source! This AI should make playing on your own games much more interesting, though they aren't perfect, not yet at least, but you should see a big improvement... Or maybe you won't see it, as the AI run away from you once you tag them.

This new AI has a number of neat features, such as:

    
 Using sight and sound to determine where players are
 Hiding from too many enemies, or after they've been tagged
 Positioning around targets to optimize hit chance and avoid line of sight
 aiming up/down to the best sensor to aim at
 There's still a lot to improve with the AI:
 fixing movement bugs, improving the AI's senses when it's moving
 fixing weapon firing glitches
 implementing advanced movement with aim stabilization, jumping, crouching, etc.
 support for different gametypes, and team coordination AI


Stay tuned for when the plugin reaches open source. This is the first element in our plan to releasing robust modding tools for you to contribute your own content to- maybe you want to make an AI that behaves for your crazy gametype, go for it once it's ready!

Improved aiming systems

https://i.imgur.com/dW3u4ZS.gif

Aiming always felt bad before now, but now that changes! With alt fire/right click, you can focus in on where you're aiming your laser gun, and hit distant shots with better precision. Additionally, crouching helps further reduce this aim offset, while moving and jumping actually hurt it.

Simple character customization

https://i.imgur.com/AGy8ggg.png

We're getting started on providing you options for customizing looks and styles! Currently, you can set your preferred primary and secondary colors and see your style in action in FFA matches. There's also settings to switch to the WIP third person and right handed modes (we're hoping to refine these features, and get some better customization ready, in the update after). Bots even have their own favorite colors in FFA now. What color pairs fit your style?

Patchnotes


seasonal themes
 removed Christmas theme (it's May...)
Endscreen/Podium
 See who won and had the most points at the end of the game!
Audio system
 Music in LaserArena now plays dynamically based on match state
 Added Steam Audio, which should provide more dynamic and realistic SFX throughout the game
 Laser gun charge/discharge audio fixed
Map changes
LaserArena: Added a starry ceiling
LaserArena: improved visibility
Social systems
 Steam invites added- send invites for friends to join directly through the Steam friends list!
 Discord presence- Discord now shows what game and map you're currently playing on
 We're looking forward to adding more social systems with Steam and Discord into the game soon, including Discord invites and group party system!
Other
 Lasers get stuck less on sensors on the weapon; lasers are now fully visible in mirrors and reflections
 fixed various UI issues
 Fixed many issues related to connections. Game now uses the Steam Sockets API, which should let anyone host with ease
 Fixed various UI elements, including implementing the correct colors for players/teams
 And more... Ask us what else has changed! There were many small and big changes, it's difficult to keep track of what exactly changed from the last update compared to this.


Known Issues

 Gameplay intro music plays twice when the match starts
 UI related issues with the demo recording playback. We are working on a UI overhaul to fix this!
 Players can clip and get stuck into geometry by uncrouching with an obstacle above them
 Clients might not be able to crouch, or see the server owner's character tilt
 The endscreen/podium doesn't show on clients
 Scoreboard doesn't show on clients
 Pop-up scoring UI during gameplay shows 0 points on clients
 Not all network errors are correctly reported to the player


Any other issues or feedback? Let us know at our Discord server! https://quantonium.net/discord

notes.title: Beta 24-12-2 hotfix
notes.content:
An update to the recently release beta 24-12-x update has just been released!


 Fixed multiplayer games not showing in the server browser (note that duplicates may still appear listed). If this issue still persists, please report it in the Discord server.
 Invite or join friends' games over Steam! Simply right-click another user in Steam and either join game, or invite to game.
 Began some tweaking of the AI though nothing noticeable yet


If there are any further issues feel free to tell us on the Discord server, https://quantonium.net/discord.

Have a happy holidays, and keep tagging!

notes.title: Update Beta 24-12-1
notes.content:
The Laser Games update beta 24-11-1 is now live!

The big change: nametags!

Nametags are now added to each player! While by default the nametags will be set to a team-default value, they are set up to allow for custom styles so your name can be your own style, as well as server override control for your future mods.

The nametag object is also set up to be versatile for modding and design- we hope to use this as the base for a tutorial level in a future update!

Server creation and searching

The game searching menu has been fixed and updated- now you can find open games via Steam networking, and filter by LAN, with additional filters coming soon.

We also redesigned the game creation menu for a more streamlined experience, and to make room for future settings regarding gametypes and maps. Hosting games should be simple and easy now!

Additional major changes


 Fixed issue where players sometimes won't spawn in properly, especially in cases of high latency- this was caused by the HUD not spawning in.
 fixed weapon audio charge sounds when playing on a server.
 fixed a bug which bots would abuse which allowed them to spam weapon fire right after running out of charge.
 Fixed and optimized some network replication issues.


What's next?

 Dedicated server support, and customization for maps and gametypes.
 basic player customization: set your name and favorite colors!
 Free-For-All: it was in the prototype but hasn't been updated in a while
 improved weapon and character models
 map cleanup; additional maps and gametypes


Persisting issues


 AI players are still dumb, this is something that we are looking into extensively to improve.
 Nametags have just been released, but if there are any cases where you don't seem them for other players, let us know!
 In the server browser, games may show up more than once.
 There might be some menu issues after leaving a game and going back to the main menu
 3rd person mode and the right hand switch (set to keys c and v if you want to see for yourself) are still buggy. The character still doesn't know how to properly hold onto the weapon, so shooting can still appear to trail off.


Anything else?
In spirit of the holidays... Hop into the game for a festive surprise!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242191/abca7e09990ffd5e974a92e28b17849bb1f62186.png


Share your scores! Give us feedback!

Share your scores, discuss the game, and report issues or thoughts, we want to hear from you! Join the Discord to share and discuss!

Start playtesting the update now!

notes.title: beta-24-10-1 patchnotes
notes.content:
The Laser Games is now officially open to playtesting! If you haven't already, join our Discord at https://quantonium.net/discord for the latest updates and to provide feedback for the playtest.

beta-24-10-1

 Added a screenshot button- easily capture your scorecard and share with friends over Steam!
